name: Latanoprost
description: Prostaglandin F2α analogue eye drop, tried on the scalp for hair loss

status.humanEvidence: FDA approved (eyes); hair: two small pilots

note.text: A Phase III trial of a combination solution is recruiting, with no results posted. No compounded spray has been tested.

bullets: **Prodrug:** corneal esterases turn it into the active acid, per the label
**Lowers eye pressure** mainly by raising uveoscleral outflow
**Lash changes** (longer, thicker, more lashes) are a labeled effect
**On the scalp,** the mechanism is not established
Hair: two small pilots, 16 men and 29 women

practical.routes: Eye drops; on the scalp in small trials (off-label)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Ester prodrug hydrolyzed in the cornea; liver β-oxidation
practical.soldAs: Rx eye drops (Xalatan); compounded scalp sprays
practical.monitored: Hair counts and density (pilots); eye pigment (label)

regulatory.text: Approved for eye pressure (1996); not hair loss

references: Blume-Peytavi et al., J Am Acad Dermatol, latanoprost on the scalp, May 2012
Rakowska et al., Pharmacol Rep, latanoprost acid in women, Aug 2026
